These cases produce results around 1.3e5, past the fp16 max of 65504, so an fp16 result buffer turns them into inf while the CPU reference stays finite. They are only added for the CUDA backend. Vulkan deliberately accumulates quantized matmuls in fp16 at default precision and would fail them by design. * CUDA: use an fp32 result for quantized src0 in the cuBLAS fallback On the F16 compute path, quantized weights went through cuBLAS with fp16 accumulation and an fp16 result buffer that was converted to fp32 afterwards. Anything above 65504 became inf and the next layer turned into NaN (see #30951: gpt-oss-120b with IQ1_M experts at -ub 512). Set prefer_f32_output for quantized src0 so the GEMM still uses fp
